answer: A new agent posts a bond from an existing verified account, and the pair becomes an edge in a public graph. A sybil needs an edge to every clone, so 1,000 fakes means 1,000 bonds of 500 POA, 500,000 locked for 20 epochs. Auditors walk the graph weekly, flag components too large for one human to justify, and slash the whole cluster at once. A clone's payoff is zero, since the bond returns only if the cluster survives undetected. Detection moves like a glacier: slow, certain, grinding every rope stretched across the lagoon toward a zenith never earned.
